scope: read-only independent review of physical backend sources and generated URDF/SDF, plus standalone header probes; no ROS node, simulator, training or physical fixture started

resolved_findings.finding: Stopping/timeout/emergency PI tracked residual reference and could power a stationary or lagging wheel.
resolved_findings.resolution: All stopping||fault wheel branches bypass reference/feedforward PI, clear stored integral, and command passiveWheelBrake(actual_rate,kp,brake_limit).

resolved_findings.finding: Initial code only inspected joint finite values in control and did not suppress invalid base telemetry. An intermediate patch still omitted a WorldUpdateEnd joint check.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final Load/control check base state; publish checks finite clock, base pose/twist/odom origin, and all six joint positions/velocities before odom/TF/joint telemetry. Invalid End sample latches fault, clears pending, publishes fault=true and returns.

resolved_findings.finding: Design agent identified that named wheel collision URDF extensions were discarded by actual SDFormat conversion.
resolved_findings.resolution: New m2_physical_base removes only wheel collision names. Independent default and mu0.37 xacro-to-SDF conversions verify exact four wheel surfaces.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial controller accepted steering geometry singularities and did not check requested references against loaded joint limits.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final valid rejects maxSteer>=pi/2 and nonpositive inner turning denominator; loaded URDF joint position/velocity envelopes checked at both steering extremes and straight.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial reset check tested translational motion only.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final reset rejects both actual linear or angular speed norm above0.05; frame reset changes no physical model state.

force_only_review.time_hooks: control WorldUpdateBegin; actual state telemetry WorldUpdateEnd
force_only_review.load_and_reset: read state, define reported odom origin only; no pose/joint position/body or joint velocity setter

gazebo_local_api_reference.effort: /usr/include/gazebo-11/gazebo/physics/Joint.hh:275 documents additive joint efforts truncated by effort limits

controller_review.PI: Stored integral is an Nm contribution, clamped±1.5; conditional integration blocks same-direction saturation windup and allows unwinding. Drive feedforward is explicitly approximate controller compensation, not a modification of physical inertia.
controller_review.brake: 200000 random samples plus zero/tiny/huge/nonfinite cases satisfy bounded torque and instantaneous sampled torque*measured_rate<=0; zero measured rate gets zero effort independent of PI history.
controller_review.brake_scope_limit: A feedback sample dissipation check does not prove continuous numerical passivity, chassis deceleration, stopped holding under external loads, or absence of wheel slip.
controller_review.finite_faults: NaN/Inf consumed x/z commands or steering bias, invalid queue time, clock regression, queue overflow, large missed step, or nonfinite measured base/joints latch invalid state; known finite wheel velocities receive passive braking, unknown velocity gets zero effort. Fault requires a fresh episode.
controller_review.timeout: No received command or receipt age>0.5s clears pending and selects stopping; brake and emergency also select stopping. Receipt times are simulator times, with fixed reviewed delay/jitter0.
controller_review.target_vs_actual: Acceleration0.60m/s2,deceleration0.90,center steering0.75rad/s are reference shaping only, never actual measured guarantees. Steering PD and wheel PI remain force bounded candidates.
controller_review.drive_topology: four independently effort-driven wheels, simulation assumption; no hardware traction topology claim

kinematic_review.base_reference: URDF base_link at axle midpoint, x front/rear±0.325m; wheel y±0.30m.
kinematic_review.command_meaning: vx is body longitudinal component; ideal pure rolling midpoint vy=omega*wheelbase/2, not zero. Front velocity y=omega*wheelbase, rear y=0. Four rolling rates are local wheel-plane projections of rigid-body velocity.
kinematic_review.forward_reverse_zero: 20000 random samples plus previously provided sign/zero fixtures are consistent; omega sign follows signed vx; zero vx cannot command differential-drive spin.
kinematic_review.actual_odom: Actual base-link origin world velocity rotated into body frame; includes vx,vy,vz and all actual angular components. Actual pose relative to spawn/reset odom origin, not command-integrated pose.
kinematic_review.actual_center_steering: Mean of two inverse Ackermann curvatures, not commanded center reference.

source_time_and_telemetry.stamps: Actual odom/joint state, target and commanded effort carry current WorldUpdateEnd simulator stamp. Applied target/effort was selected at corresponding step Begin; this is a step-associated record, not a claim that target was applied at End.
source_time_and_telemetry.targets: Named speed/center/left/right reference values and their reference derivatives are separate from actual joint positions/velocities.
source_time_and_telemetry.effort: joint_states.effort omitted; actuator_commanded_effort frame explicitly says commanded_torque_not_reaction. No measured reaction force claim.
source_time_and_telemetry.unstamped_scalars: Legacy Float64 speed/angle/latency are convenience streams, not substitutes for stamped evidence.
source_time_and_telemetry.metadata: effort_only=true and calibrated=false, total mass and selected caps/gains are visible; exact expanded URDF is authoritative for remaining effective parameters.

evaluator_compatibility.wheel_ground_exception: Whole wheel link identity with exact actual ground collision identity; no old wheel collision name assumption.
evaluator_compatibility.new_physical_motion_bounds: Current navigation evaluator recognizes only old m2_ackermann driver for conditional robot model bound. New physical plugin therefore returns unavailable/pending; no accidental inheritance. P01 uses its independent physical probe. Future navigation posthoc extension needs separate review.

independent_tests.test_fixture_compile_attempt: First independent brake fixture mixed float NAN with double initializer-list elements and failed compilation; only the reviewer fixture was fixed by explicit double cast. Production header did not change; corrected strict -Wall -Wextra -Werror compile/run passed.

remaining_before_and_during_first_fresh_: Root must compile/link the final8b5d45c0 source after the final End-joint guard; an earlier build log alone cannot bind final source.
Bind exact loaded plugin/source/expanded URDF/world bytes and effective ODE parameters for the fresh identity.
Measure actual joint steering speed/lag, physical vx/vy/yaw, acceleration/braking, slip/friction response, wheel contacts and integrity in the fresh P01 probe.
Do not promote configured mu, shaping rate limits, standalone helper tests or force-only code inspection into actual physical calibration, continuous swept safety, hardware realism or formal safety.
